title: 同一條上班路，五天的穿搭
viewer_takeaway: 她每天走同一段到公司的路，穿搭隨日子變化。
direction_source: User asks for a continuous short route from the street corner opposite the company, through colonnade, plaza and crossing, into the company; tracking camera curves around the model. Clothes change while space and movement continue.

space.type: one fictional company-front site, not a real mapped address
space.coordinate_units: schematic relative units; not surveyed distances

camera.type: one continuous follow path with a gradual arc relative to walking direction
camera.framing: full outfit; constant camera distance, continuous camera position and yaw
camera.note: Angle follows a whole-route curve, not a new angle prescribed independently for each outfit. Camera moves from front three-quarter to side to rear three-quarter as she nears the doorway.

segments.label: 街角走出
segments.purpose: 用長西外與深藍褲建立人物與通勤方向。
segments.location: 公司對面街角轉入騎樓；遠處保留同一棟公司。

segments.label: 沿騎樓前行
segments.purpose: 步伐延續，外層改短版；公司與柱列位置不重設。
segments.location: 同一排騎樓，接到旁邊退縮的小廣場。

segments.label: 走過小廣場
segments.purpose: 灰褲保留，改成格紋上身；鏡頭弧形跟到側面。
segments.location: 騎樓旁的小廣場，前方已能辨認同一條斑馬線。

segments.label: 過街走向公司
segments.purpose: 轉向公司；白襯衫與黑裙的輪廓在步行中可讀。
segments.location: 同一路口的短斑馬線；公司入口就在對面。

segments.label: 抵達公司門口
segments.purpose: 保留白襯衫，換棕丹寧；鏡頭逐漸落到斜後方，跟到門檻收束。
segments.location: 過街後接同一公司入口，不再換另一棟樓。

continuity_contract: Wardrobe changes never reset the world position, camera position, viewpoint, step phase, direction, light or background pedestrians.
All five places belong to the same compact company-front area; no jump to distant locations.
If generated separately, next segment uses the same endpoint geometry and continuing camera path, with a new approved outfit-specific starting image.
Retain around0.75s soft changes; do not infer that this authorizes hard cuts or mask/wipe alternatives.
The shared environment is designed before outfit stills; separate text prompts alone cannot guarantee it.
open_editorial_limits: The no-text film may communicate a stylish commuting sequence without making five distinct weekdays explicit; do not claim that interpretation is verified. Caption can name same-route/five-days when copy is requested.
19.5s and the exact geometry/camera arc are drafts, not user-specified exact timings or proven IG rules.
Rear three-quarter ending adds garment/back-identity information requirements before production.
Line figures are only spatial markers; their limb errors are outside this review per user.
production_stage: No photoreal still/Grok generation. Confirm whole-route spatial logic first, then derive a shared environment and compatible starting frames. Existing source/approval scopes retained.
approval_status: user provided concept; this exact route drawing and animatic pending review
